major_events.event: Xu Fengnian reveals his true identity in Longjing County to suppress veteran General Zhong Hongwu and executes corrupt secondary officers.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十一章 摘刀撕面

major_events.event: General Zhong Hongwu is intimidated by Xu Fengnian's deadly flying swords and submits to the heir of North Liang.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十二章 参见世子殿下

major_events.event: Xu Beizhi publicly announces that Xu Fengnian decapitated enemy leaders Xu Huainan and Diwu He, establishing the new heir's military prestige.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十三章 两份谋略两颗头颅，贺新凉

major_events.event: The six feudal kings of the Liyang Dynasty enter Tai'an City to attend court, signaling intense political maneuvers.
Li Chungang utilizes his remaining sword energy to make two grand wishes for all future sword practitioners before his death.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第九章 李淳罡两愿天下剑士

major_events.event: Xu Fengnian wears his North Liang saber to the imperial court in Tai'an City and refuses to kneel on the palace steps.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第十章 佩凉刀上朝

major_events.event: Wen Hua rejects Huang Longshi's scheme to assassinate Xu Fengnian, disabling his own meridians and breaking his wooden sword to leave the martial world.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第十六章 一人想赠剑春秋，一人折剑出江湖

major_events.event: Xu Fengnian meets Empress Zhao Zhi and First Prince Zhao Wu in Tai'an City, calling her Aunt Zhao due to old family ties.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第二十三章 桌上皇帝两字

major_events.event: Wudang's new leader Li Yufu and veteran master Wang Xiaopin meet in Tai'an City, returning the sword Shentu and realizing the vision of Zhenwu.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第三十一章 真武见我

major_events.event: Xu Fengnian fights Nanhai Guanyin Sect practitioners at Spring Shen Lake, condensing millions of snowflakes into flying snow swords.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第三十八章 我以黑剑杀白雪

major_events.event: Jiang Ni and Cao Changqing overlook the Liyang Dynasty's political layout from the cloud sea, acknowledging their role as pawns.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第四十六章 过河卒子

major_events.event: Xu Fengnian confronts a bizarre assembly of Demon Sect remnants led by dynamic figures at Longwei slope.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第五十三章 魔高一丈

major_events.event: Century-old Demon Sect Leader Liu Songtao fights Luo Yang and subsequently returns a sword to Xu Fengnian in the city.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第六十一章 晚来天欲雪

major_events.event: Xu Fengnian is ambushed in an orchard by North Mang master killers, including Murong Longshui and Yi Jieliu, and tears Yi Jieliu apart.
Song Nianqing from Dongyue Sword Pond perishes in battle against Luo Yang, while imperial helper Liu Haoshi ambushes Luo Yang and blows Xu Fengnian away.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第八十三章 最后一趟江湖

major_events.event: The old patriarch of the Lu family, Lu Feichi, passes away in Xiangfan City after handing a symbolic lantern to his grandson Lu Dongjiang.
Xu Fengnian promotes and rewards minor officers Wang Yunshu and Jiao Wuyi in Huangnan County.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第一百一十三章 骤然富贵

major_events.event: Second-generation North Liang King Xu Fengnian and North Mang Empress meet in the snow at the border, recalling their past connection.
major_events.anchor_chapter: 第一百四十三章 帝王相逢风雪中

major_events.event: The second-class maid Huanggua is found dead in Wutong Yard, and Xu Fengnian shifts focus to the military mechanism agency Jizaoju.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Face-Mask Disguise and Identity Revelation: Protagonist travels in disguise to inspect local administration and execute corrupt officials, creating dramatic tension resolved upon public identity revelation.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十一章 摘刀撕面

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: The Sword-Wish and Legacy Inheritance: The passing of senior sword masters is accompanied by spiritual wishes and legacy inheritances (like returning famous swords), passing the mantle to the next generation.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第九章 李淳罡两愿天下剑士

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Feudal-Imperial Courtyard Politics and Hostage Tactics: The imperial center uses feudal gatherings, court rituals, and marriages of state to neutralize and spy on the powerful regional vassal states.

Saber/Sword Duality and Martial Synthesis: Protagonist synthesis of different schools of martial arts, using flying swords from the Nanhai Guanyin Sect and classic saber style to create a hybrid combat style.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第三十八章 我以黑剑杀白雪

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Chao-Ye (Court and Martial World) Intersecting Sovereignty: Establishment of a court-backed Martial Arts Alliance Leader (Wulin Mengzhu) as a tool for the imperial court to regulate and recruit the martial world.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第六十八章 守不住寡的江湖

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Dynastic/Factional Decay and Succession Transitions: Transition of power in declining factions (like the Qing party) where old leaders pass symbolic tokens to secure the survival of their lineage.
The Military Mechanism Agency (Jizaoju) and Logistics: Heavy investment of North Liang in the Jizaoju to mass-produce weapons and armor, forming the material basis of defiance against enemies.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第一百五十八章 北凉要跟北莽离阳讲道理

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism: Imperial Borderland Diplomacy: Personal secret meetings between rulers (North Liang King and North Mang Empress) in remote borderlands, resolving historically complex relations.
long_form_mechanisms.anchor_chapter: 第一百四十三章 帝王相逢风雪中

continuity_observations.observation: Li Chungang's famous 'Sword Come' (剑来) phenomenon at Mount Hui Daxue坪 is cited as the historical precedent for Xu Fengnian's mass sword control at Spring Shen Lake.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第三十八章 我以黑剑杀白雪

continuity_observations.observation: The legacy of Prince Zhao's old friendship with Wu Su is referenced during Xu Fengnian's tense conversation with Empress Zhao Zhi, reflecting the tragic fallout of the Capital White-Clothing Incident.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第二十三章 桌上皇帝两字

continuity_observations.observation: Wudang's connection to the mythical Emperor Zhenwu is maintained, linking the old stories of Hong Xixiang and Li Yufu's spiritual vision.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第三十一章 真武见我

continuity_observations.observation: The execution of Fifth貉 (Diwu He) and Xu Huainan is officially disseminated across North Liang to establish the military prestige of the heir, confirming the aftermath of his previous Northern Mang travels.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十三章 两份谋略两颗头颅，贺新凉

continuity_observations.observation: The background of dead soldier 'Yin' (寅) is noted as a legendary assassin who participated in the previous plot against imperial tutor Yuan Benxi.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第四十六章 过河卒子

continuity_observations.observation: The Nanhai Guanyin Sect's signature technique 'Finger Sword' (指剑) is shown to be a rare Daoist cultivation milestone that was previously blocked.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第三十八章 我以黑剑杀白雪

continuity_observations.observation: The history of the Demon Sect (Mo Jiao) being crushed by Taoist immortal Qi Xuanzhen sixty years ago is cited when the new generation of Demon Sect members attempts to recruit Xu Fengnian.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第五十三章 魔高一丈

continuity_observations.observation: The presence of character Xu Beizhi as a key advisor is sustained, tracking his escape from Northern Mang and his integration into the North Liang civil administration.
continuity_observations.anchor_chapter: 第一百编制一章 开门不见山

style_observations.details: The narrative frequently juxtaposes grand, earth-shaking martial clashes (such as sword qi covering a lake) with extremely mundane domestic actions (like roasting sweet potatoes or selecting a cheap mink cap).
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第八十三章 最后一趟江湖

style_observations.details: The dialogue between Xu Xiao and Xu Fengnian features a rhythmic pattern of blunt, vulgar retorts followed by quiet, deep emotional nods, highlighting their complex father-son dynamic.
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第一百六十七章 亭中三言两语定江湖

style_observations.details: The text employs rich, classically derived Daoist and Buddhist terminology (e.g. 太乙狮子诀, 劾鬼之术, 指剑) to explain the internal mechanisms of energy manipulation.
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第三十一章 真武见我

style_observations.details: Using specific visual symbols (like the red-fox fur hat, the broken wooden sword, or a single lantern) to anchor the emotional resolution of a scene or character departure.
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第十六章 一人想赠剑春秋，一人折剑出江湖

style_observations.details: Important transitions are set against severe weather backdrops, particularly heavy snowfall, which serves to intensify the tragic or historic tone of the meetings and duels.
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第一百四十三章 帝王相逢风雪中

style_observations.details: Characters use crude, humorous vernacular metaphors (such as comparing the sky's clouds to 'plucking geese' or comparing martial factions to '俏寡妇' / pretty widows) to defuse high-tension political situations.
style_observations.anchor_chapter: 第六十八章 守不住寡的江湖

creation_family_evidence.paragraph_indentation: Every paragraph consistently starts with two full-width Chinese spaces (`　　`).
creation_family_evidence.chapter_headings_format: Chapter headings are formatted on their own line with no indentation (e.g., `第一百六十七章 亭中三言两语定江湖`), using Chinese numerals instead of Arabic numerals.
creation_family_evidence.text_corruption_giggle: At line 5900, there is a textual typo/corruption `功勋狭摇１境` containing the only digit in the entire text (a full-width digit `１`), likely resulting from a scanning or digitization error in the source novel text.
creation_family_evidence.no_external_advertisements: The text is extremely clean and free of web addresses, VIP chapter notices, scan group signatures, or brackets.

originality_risks.details: The trope of a high-status noble traveling in low-class disguise to expose local corruption is a classic cliché of traditional Chinese wuxia novels.
originality_risks.anchor_chapter: 第一百七十一章 摘刀撕面

originality_risks.details: Having a veteran master sacrifice their remaining life force to unleash a spectacular final strike to teach or protect the younger generation is a standard wuxia/xianxia trope.
originality_risks.anchor_chapter: 第九章 李淳罡两愿天下剑士

originality_risks.details: The trope of a character breaking their own meridians, limbs, or weapons to pay back a debt of honor to a master is a well-worn wuxia convention.
originality_risks.anchor_chapter: 第十六章 一人想赠剑春秋，一人折剑出江湖

originality_risks.details: Linking characters to the reincarnation of ancient deities (like Emperor Zhenwu) risks overusing the 'Chosen One' trope, where the protagonist's success is pre-ordained by cosmic heritage.
originality_risks.anchor_chapter: 第三十一章 真武见我

originality_risks.details: Killing off minor maids (like Huanggua) to motivate the protagonist or highlight the coldness of political struggles is a common dramatic shorthand.
originality_risks.anchor_chapter: 第一百五十八章 北凉要跟北莽离阳讲道理
